children: has operated at 105% to 108% of capacity over the last six months, a senior company official said on Wednesday, adding that higher diesel demand is pushing refiners to prioritise diesel over jet fuel.

"Most of our trains (in the refinery) are complex, can take a wide variety of crude from API range from something like 16 to 45 or 48," said Nandakumar Pillai, a company director, at the APPEC conference.
